author: Aaronjacobs000
notes: Juniper Mist webhooks for the audits, alarms and nac-events topics. Mist sends these as a batch, {"topic": ..., "events": [...]}, with several events in one body, and offers single_event_per_message only for other topics, so send them through the webhook relay in bridges/webhook-relay with BRIDGE_SPLIT_BATCHES=1, which checks X-Mist-Signature-v2 and forwards each event as its own record in the same envelope. The parsers read the first event of a record, so a batch sent straight to HTTP Ingest keeps only its first event. README.md has the setup. Audits go to CloudAudit with the message as the event name and the email in admin_name as the user. Alarms go to ThirdPartyAlert with the alarm type as the title, the group (security, infrastructure or marvis) as the category, and Mist's severity (critical to Critical, warn to Medium, info to Info). Mist Access Assurance NAC events go to Auth with the event type as the status; they carry no client IP address. The parent claims a record with topic first or last, compact or spaced, and leaves other topics alone. Samples follow Juniper's webhook message samples and the Mist API's alarm and NAC event definitions, with made-up values. Each child, combined with the parent into one parser, passed Run Test in a lab tenant on 2026-10-15 (132 of 132 fields matched the emulator in each of 3 runs), and the parent's confirm string picked the same records there. Each child also passed Run Test as a separate parser under its parent (132 of 132 fields, each line taken in 5 of 5 runs). No built-in parser claimed these records.
